scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Name of the global scope for this application (organizational tenant)

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Name of the cluster running this application (platform tenant)

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Name of the environment for this application (ex: dev, factory, preprod or prod)

component.title: Component
component.description: Component name of this application (logical tenant)

app.title: App
app.description: Application name (functional tenant, default use Chart name)

version.title: Version
version.description: Version name of this application (default use Chart appVersion)

externalSecretDefaults.title: External Secret Defaults
externalSecretDefaults.description: Default settings applied to every ExternalSecret rendered by this chart when a secret is sourced from an external store (`externalSecret.enabled: true`). Requires the External Secrets Operator and a SecretStore/ClusterSecretStore.

apiVersion.title: Api Version
apiVersion.description: API version of the ExternalSecret CRD (external-secrets.io/v1beta1 for ESO releases without the v1 API)

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval
refreshInterval.description: How often the Secret is refreshed from the external store

secretStoreRef.title: Secret Store Ref
secretStoreRef.description: Store to read from (name is required as soon as a secret uses externalSecret)

csm.title: Csm
csm.description: Deploy the ContainerStorageModule CR (the Dell CSI driver managed by the CSM operator)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the ContainerStorageModule CR in the project namespace

hooked.title: Hooked
hooked.description: Activate the resource as a helm hook

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the ContainerStorageModule CR (the driver reads the array credentials from the Secret "<name>-config")

driverType.title: Driver Type
driverType.description: Dell CSI driver to deploy (csiDriverType) : powerstore, powermax, powerflex, isilon (PowerScale) or unity

version.title: Version
version.description: CSM release deployed by the operator (spec.version, ex: v1.18.2). The installed operator only accepts the CSM releases listed in its operatorconfig/common/csm-releases.yaml (https://github.com/dell/csm-operator) ; operator 1.13.x supports CSM v1.16.0 to v1.18.2

configVersion.title: Config Version
configVersion.description: Deprecated driver configuration version (spec.driver.configVersion, ex: v2.18.1 for PowerStore). Leave empty to rely on `version` ; only used by operators older than CSM 1.16

replicas.title: Replicas
replicas.description: Number of replicas of the controller plugin

authSecret.title: Auth Secret
authSecret.description: Name of the Secret holding the array credentials (empty means "<name>-config"). Without authSecret the operator would look for "<name>-config" (PowerStore, PowerFlex) or "<name>-creds" (PowerMax, PowerScale, Unity)

common.title: Common
common.description: Settings shared by the controller and the node plugins

image.title: Image
image.description: Custom driver image (empty means the image shipped with the operator release)

imagePullPolicy.title: Image Pull Policy
imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the driver image

envs.title: Envs
envs.description: Environment variables merged in spec.driver.common.envs (raw list, operator defaults apply when empty)

dnsPolicy.title: Dns Policy
dnsPolicy.description: DNS policy of the node plugin daemonset

forceRemoveDriver.title: Force Remove Driver
forceRemoveDriver.description: Remove the driver deployment when the CR is deleted

csiDriverSpec.title: Csi Driver Spec
csiDriverSpec.description: CSIDriver object created by the operator

fSGroupPolicy.title: F SGroup Policy
fSGroupPolicy.description: fsGroupPolicy of the CSIDriver (ReadWriteOnceWithFSType, File or None ; immutable on OCP 4.16 and older)

storageCapacity.title: Storage Capacity
storageCapacity.description: Enable storage capacity tracking used by the scheduler

controller.title: Controller
controller.description: Controller plugin (deployment talking to the array management API)

infra_enabled.title: Infra enabled
infra_enabled.description: Run the controller plugin on infra nodes (infra nodeSelector and toleration)

nodeSelector.title: Node Selector
nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the controller plugin (ignored when infra_enabled is true)

tolerations.title: Tolerations
tolerations.description: Tolerations of the controller plugin (ignored when infra_enabled is true)

envs.title: Envs
envs.description: Environment variables merged in spec.driver.controller.envs (raw list)

node.title: Node
node.description: Node plugin (daemonset mounting the volumes on every node)

infra_enabled.title: Infra enabled
infra_enabled.description: Let the node plugin run on infra nodes too (adds the infra toleration, no nodeSelector)

nodeSelector.title: Node Selector
nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the node plugin

tolerations.title: Tolerations
tolerations.description: Tolerations of the node plugin (ignored when infra_enabled is true)

envs.title: Envs
envs.description: Environment variables merged in spec.driver.node.envs (raw list)

sideCars.title: Side Cars
sideCars.description: CSI sidecar containers overrides (raw list rendered in spec.driver.sideCars, operator defaults apply when empty)

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: CSM modules (raw list rendered in spec.modules) : replication, observability, resiliency, authorization

extraSpec.title: Extra Spec
extraSpec.description: Extra fields appended to the ContainerStorageModule spec (raw map, ex: upgrade, customRegistry)

arraySecret.title: Array Secret
arraySecret.description: Credentials of the Dell storage arrays used by the driver (Secret mounted by the controller and node plugins)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the array credentials Secret

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the Secret (empty means csm.authSecret, then "<csm.name>-config")

config.title: Config
config.default:
arrays:
  - endpoint: "https://powerstore.example.com/api/rest"
    globalID: "PS000000000000"
    username: "csmadmin"
    password: "changeme"
    skipCertificateValidation: true
    isDefault: true
    blockProtocol: "auto"
    nasName: "nas-server"
config.description: Dell array configuration stored in the "config" key of the Secret (raw YAML text, one entry per array). PowerStore fields: endpoint, globalID, username, password, skipCertificateValidation, isDefault, blockProtocol (FC, ISCSI, NVMeTCP, NVMeFC, None or auto), nasName (NFS). PowerFlex, PowerScale and Unity use the same "config" key with their own layout (see the Dell CSM documentation)

externalSecret.title: External Secret
externalSecret.description: Source this Secret from an external store instead of the values above: renders an ExternalSecret producing the same Secret (key "config")

storageClasses.title: Storage Classes
storageClasses.description: StorageClasses provisioned by the Dell CSI driver

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the StorageClasses

hooked.title: Hooked
hooked.description: Activate the StorageClasses as a helm hook

provisioner.title: Provisioner
provisioner.description: CSIDriver name used as provisioner (empty means the driver of csm.driverType : csi-powerstore.dellemc.com, csi-powermax.dellemc.com, csi-vxflexos.dellemc.com, csi-isilon.dellemc.com or csi-unity.dellemc.com)

isDefault.title: Is Default
isDefault.description: Make this StorageClass the default one of the cluster (must be unique)

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: Driver specific parameters (raw YAML text). PowerStore: arrayID (globalID of the array, optional when the array is flagged isDefault in the secret), csi.storage.k8s.io/fstype (ext4, xfs or nfs), nasName, allowRoot, nfsAcls

reclaimPolicy.title: Reclaim Policy
reclaimPolicy.description: Reclaim policy of the provisioned volumes (Delete or Retain)

allowVolumeExpansion.title: Allow Volume Expansion
allowVolumeExpansion.description: Enable the expansion of the provisioned volumes

volumeBindingMode.title: Volume Binding Mode
volumeBindingMode.description: Binding mode of the provisioned volumes (Immediate or WaitForFirstConsumer)

mountOptions.title: Mount Options
mountOptions.description: Mount options applied to the provisioned volumes

volumeSnapshotClasses.title: Volume Snapshot Classes
volumeSnapshotClasses.description: VolumeSnapshotClasses used to snapshot the volumes of the Dell CSI driver

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the VolumeSnapshotClasses

hooked.title: Hooked
hooked.description: Activate the VolumeSnapshotClasses as a helm hook

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: CSIDriver name handling the snapshots (empty means the driver of csm.driverType)

isDefault.title: Is Default
isDefault.description: Make this VolumeSnapshotClass the default one of the cluster (must be unique)

veleroEnabled.title: Velero Enabled
veleroEnabled.description: Label the class for the CSI snapshots of Velero / OADP

deletionPolicy.title: Deletion Policy
deletionPolicy.description: Deletion policy of the snapshots (Delete or Retain)
